newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down three cents to 14.65 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down three cents to 14.65 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell three cents to 14.65 ringgit ($5.85) a kg despite a steady overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"There were many offers right at the opening, which buying could not match," said a dealer.

Initial offers totalled 61 tonnes against bids of 39, said dealers. Turnover was 49 tonnes, compared to 73 on Tuesday. Buyers were from Japan and Malaysia. The local premium against the LME fell to $25 from $30.
